title: A work order link from another location still asks to switch
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: After the release you open a link to a work order made at your other location.
  • You are an Admin user (the "Admin" role) working at {Location-A}, your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} was made at {Location-B}, and you have a link to it copied from the address bar.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-41001.
  • Starting screen: the release is installed; Work Orders is open at {Location-A} in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Paste the link to {Work-order-1} into the address bar.
  2. Press Enter.
  3. Click "Cancel".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the link shows in the address bar.
  • Step 2: the existing switch-location prompt asks to switch to {Location-B}, as before the release.
  • Step 3: the prompt closes and you are on Work Orders, with its message, as before the release.
